zh-Hans: 324：补齐 App 签名的 Wi-Fi 信息权限，并保留整批内部接入修复。文件默认列表并保留缩略图切换，增加作品／文件夹删除与恢复，补任务文件树、搜索和预览的删除入口；工具箱顶部横向展示加完整列表，补网关默认值、诊断／导出、文件校验及AI分析停止与超时反馈；普通聊天接通WebSocket／匿名MQTT与会话通信记录。加工与3D打印归入CAD加工入口，补机床设置、逐步去料预览和切片后自动进入“预览”。画布复用原框架并回收无引用旧快照、保留完整撤销；补CAD实体读取、改名保存、DXF回导、建筑墙房间工具和导入网格雕刻。补素材导入、字幕、音乐、化学和音频波形结构化观察链路。USB原生驱动包仍单独推进，当前构建暂不包含。请重点检查菜单、开页、按钮及原定布局；本轮不重跑完整功能／稳定性验证。315正式审核及自动发布保持不变，仅内部TestFlight。
en-US: 324: Adds the Wi-Fi information entitlement to App signing and retains the internal integration repairs. Files keep the default list and optional thumbnails, with work/folder deletion and recovery, plus deletion in task file trees, search and previews. The toolbox combines a horizontal showcase with a complete list and improves gateway defaults, diagnostics, export, checksums and AI Stop/timeout feedback, plus ordinary-chat WebSocket, anonymous MQTT and session capture tools. Manufacturing and printing open through CAD, with machine setup, progressive material-removal previews and automatic Preview after slicing. The canvas reuses its original framework and collects superseded snapshots while retaining complete undo. Adds CAD inspection, rename/save, DXF import wiring, Building wall/room tools and imported-mesh sculpt preparation. Completes media, captions, music, chemistry and structured audio-waveform inspection paths. The native USB driver package remains separate and is not included. Please check menus, opening pages, controls and agreed layouts; comprehensive functional/stability qualification is not repeated. Build315 formal review and automatic release remain unchanged. Internal TestFlight only.
